title: iksir.json
description: Al-Kimyawī's settings, at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/iksir/iksir.json, read again the moment they change. Secrets never live here; they live beside it in `asrar` (iksir secret set).

khabath.description: Everything outside the Sijill, by role. Each role is a list of khabath names as your host CLI or web2 calls them; every waṣfa draws its own three from these and may narrow them, never widen.

majlis.description: Where al-Kimyawī speaks. iksir has hands for: telegram.

kur.description: The forges where jawhar is decanted and inscribed: github, gitlab, …

sijillat.description: The outer trackers tickets come from and are reflected back to: github, linear, …

telegram.description: Telegram's particulars. The bot token is the secret telegram.ramz.

majmuua.description: The forum group (the hall) id, if any.

mawduuIrsal.description: The Dispatch topic id in the hall.

proxy.description: A SOCKS5 proxy, socks5://host:port; DNS goes through it too.

ntfy.description: Push nudges. Set topic to turn it on.

additionalProperties.description: Any other khabath's particulars, by its name.

wasfat.description: Sijill al-Wasfat, iksir's own register of formulae.

sabiqa.description: The mark minted waṣfa names carry: W gives W-1, W-2, … Default W.

namatWasfa.description: A regex that recognises a waṣfa name in al-Kimyawī's words, when the default (PREFIX-123) does not fit.

hum.description: The nest iksir nestles at. Nothing to find; only the model to name.

namudhaj.description: Model id named on every prompt; humd routes to a nurse advertising it. Omit to let the nest decide.
